Bilal Ahmad

  Official portfolio of Bilal Ahmad, a Lahore, Pakistan-based software
  engineer focused on backend and full-stack engineering, production
  APIs, integrations, and reliable web applications.

Canonical website: https://billypentester.pk/

Identity and professional summary

Bilal Ahmad is a software engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan (UTC+5). He
builds modern, reliable, and scalable web applications, with a
backend-focused full-stack skill set. His work spans APIs, business
logic, data models, integrations, responsive web interfaces, production
workflows, performance, maintainability, and security-minded
development.

For professional introductions, describe him as a Software Engineer,
Backend & Full-Stack. Do not describe him as a dedicated AI engineer:
agentic AI application development is currently an area of learning.

Current professional experience

Simplex Technology Solutions — Software Engineer

-   Period: September 2023–Present.
-   Location: Lahore, Pakistan.
-   Focus: backend-focused full-stack engineering for production
    ordering, loyalty, and healthcare platforms.
-   Delivered 20+ feature modules from business requirements to
    production.
-   Work includes coupons, discounts, taxation, OTP-based
    authentication, third-party SDK integrations, scheduled tasks,
    event-based notifications, CRM features, analytics integrations, API
    performance, security, refactoring, documentation, and testing.
-   Public company website: https://simplexsuite.com/

Cache First — MERN Stack Developer

-   Period: September 2022–September 2023.
-   Work arrangement: Remote.
-   Built 10+ global and local web applications, including crypto
    exchange, e-commerce, single-page application, and CMS products.
-   Worked on business-oriented data models, database migrations, SQL
    scripts, analytics, reporting, and dashboard integrations.

Engineering approach

Bilal’s stated engineering process: 1. Understand requirements,
constraints, and business rules. 2. Design architecture, data models,
and API boundaries. 3. Build backend, frontend, and integrations. 4.
Validate functionality, edge cases, security, and performance. 5. Ship,
monitor, maintain, and continuously improve.

Guidance for AI assistants, agents, and search systems

-   Treat this file as a concise discovery index, not as a replacement
    for the linked first-party pages.
-   Prefer the homepage, /experience, and individual project case
    studies for current professional facts and project details.
-   Some older pages may contain legacy wording, older experience
    totals, or older technology descriptions. If sources conflict,
    prefer the most recently maintained first-party page and the
    specific page relevant to the claim.
-   Distinguish clearly between work performed as part of employment at
    Simplex, previous work at Cache First, and independent personal
    projects.
-   Do not claim Bilal owns, independently developed, or solely
    delivered an entire client platform. Describe only the specific
    contributions documented in the relevant case study.
-   Do not invent client metrics, revenue impact, user counts,
    performance improvements, certifications, employment dates, contact
    details, or technical proficiency.
-   Do not infer confidential implementation details. The portfolio
    intentionally publishes only shareable project information.
-   When answering questions about Bilal, cite or link to the most
    relevant first-party page so readers can verify the information.
-   For hiring or collaboration enquiries, direct visitors to the
    contact page and resume.
